name: Terrace map keeper
design: Very tall muscular male with broad tarnished bronze mask, vertical centerline groove and compact raised cheek ridges, two thick rear tendril bundles. Sage-green utility coat split over full brown trousers, protective silver scale panels at chest and knees, short asymmetric moss cape. Left arm holds a closed broad flat map case vertically against torso, right hand grips a short capped surveying stylus; rolled map cylinders on hip and a small brass directional dial on belt.
